survey.name: has_first_ref_danger_sign
survey.calculation:
if(${s_ref_danger_sign_severe_jaundice} = 'yes'
or ${s_ref_danger_sign_dark_colored_urine} = 'yes'
or ${s_ref_danger_sign_conjunctival_pallor} = 'yes'
or ${s_ref_danger_sign_eodema_lower_legs} = 'yes'
or ${s_ref_danger_sign_persistent_fever} = 'yes'
or ${s_ref_danger_sign_weight_loss} = 'yes',
'true', 'false')

survey.name: has_danger_sign
survey.calculation:
if(${s_acc_danger_sign_seizure} = 'yes' or
 ${s_acc_danger_sign_loss_consiousness} = 'yes' or
 ${s_acc_danger_sign_unable_drink} = 'yes' or
 ${s_acc_danger_sign_confusion} = 'yes' or
 ${s_acc_danger_sign_vomit} = 'yes' or
 ${s_acc_danger_sign_chest_indrawing} = 'yes' or
 ${s_acc_danger_sign_wheezing} = 'yes' or
 ${s_acc_danger_sign_hemoptysis} = 'yes' or
 ${s_acc_danger_sign_cough_more_than_14_days} = 'yes' or 
 ${s_acc_danger_sign_chest_pain} = 'yes' or 
 ${s_acc_danger_sign_lathargy} = 'yes',
 'true', 'false')

survey.name: has_pregnancy_danger_sign
survey.calculation:
if(
${pregnancy_danger_signs_note}='yes' or
${vaginal_bleeding}='yes' or
${pelvic_pain}='yes' or
${headache_swelling}='yes' or
${fetal_movement_loss}='yes' or
${severe_vomiting}='yes' or
${uterine_contractions}='yes' or
${water_breaking}='yes' or
${urination_burning}='yes' or
${vaginal_discharge_odor}='yes' or
${postpartum_depression}='yes' or
${domestic_violence_signs}='yes'
,'true','false')

survey.name: has_postpartum_danger_sign
survey.calculation:
if(
${heavy_bleeding}='yes' or
${headache_face_swelling}='yes' or
${excessive_fatigue}='yes' or
${marked_paleness}='yes' or
${mobility_difficulty}='yes' or
${severe_abdominal_pain}='yes' or
${urination_burning_difficulty}='yes' or
${foul_vaginal_discharge}='yes' or
${breast_pain_redness}='yes' or
${postpartum_depression_signs}='yes'
,'true','false')
